subject: Build first playable Spitfire flight prototype
technical_change: Creates the initial force-driven Spitfire, procedural countryside airfield, three-ray landing gear, chase camera, HUD, pause/reset and flight/capture checks. The root already contains playable code; no preceding prototype history is present.

subject: Fix keyboard input for embedded game views
technical_change: Stores physical and logical key bindings in project.godot, handles HUD shortcuts before GUI navigation, removes runtime-only binding construction and adds keycode-forwarding regression tests.

subject: Add wing guns, aircraft health and damage effects
technical_change: Adds eight visible wing-port salvos, fixed bullet/tracer/spark pools with segment sweeps, health/depletion, world-space damage effects and an initially stationary practice target. Flight destruction gates thrust and gun input.

subject: Make weapon script types explicit for parser compatibility
technical_change: Changes inferred locals to explicit StandardMaterial3D, MeshInstance3D, Vector3, int and bool types in wing_guns.gd and weapons checks; observable runtime firing logic is otherwise retained.

subject: Add a flying Stuka enemy with pursuit and return fire
technical_change: Introduces procedural inverted-gull Stuka and command-driven enemy pursuit/return fire; main.gd replaces the stationary target with EnemyAircraft. The practice-target script is retained but no longer the active encounter.

subject: Add selectable Gloster Sea Gladiator with slower biplane flight
technical_change: Adds SeaGladiator/SeaGladiatorModel, fixed-gear rejection, slower biplane force tuning and startup selection. Main/HUD lifecycle supports choosing either player aircraft rather than a single hardwired Spitfire.

subject: Extend Stuka AI encounter with terrain avoidance and clean wreck lifecycle
technical_change: Adds CombatTeams, terrain-corridor avoidance, bounded/slewed manoeuvres, grace/damage-evade handling, one-shot ground impact and delayed wreck removal. Session cleanup/HUD distinguish an enemy loss from the still-falling wreck.

subject: Add shared aircraft component damage and hitbox diagnostics
technical_change: Adds eight component definitions, hitbox areas, per-airframe profiles and integrity-driven lift/drag/torque/power/control factors. Pool skips coarse aircraft bodies for localized hits; F3 diagnostics and independent fuel hazards are integrated.

subject: Add Stuka rear gunner and persistent tactical pursuit
technical_change: Adds rear model pivots and RearGunner with shared WingGuns, self-clearance and firing arcs. Reworks airborne acquisition/persistent pursuit and uses break/scissors/yo-yo navigation targets rather than velocity changes.

subject: Rebalance Stuka gunner with human aiming and combat telemetry
technical_change: Adds Cadet/Pilot/Ace profiles, delayed observations and learned target velocity, reaction/tracking/range/lead/movement errors, burst corrections and self-geometry checks. Adds per-station range/component hit telemetry and reproducible balance fixtures.

subject: Add tested browser export and GitHub Pages deployment
technical_change: Adds Web export preset, custom browser shell, matching checked Godot/templates installer, build helper, Pages workflow, browser telemetry and smoke runner. Adds browser-friendly weapon-key guidance and bundled font/notices.

subject: Record verified web build and deploy after Pages activation
technical_change: Updates web-hosting notes with recorded build/artifact success, initial Pages-disabled deployment and owner activation. No gameplay or workflow implementation changes occur in this diff.

subject: Create CNAME
technical_change: Adds root CNAME custom-domain configuration. Its hostname is not necessary to explain gameplay architecture; the next commit deletes this file.

subject: Delete CNAME
technical_change: Deletes the just-added CNAME. No root CNAME exists at the audited snapshot; custom-domain configuration is therefore a transient historical change.

subject: Add continuous Malta world, airfield selection and persistent aircraft boarding
technical_change: Imports supplied Malta terrain/source/chart data and creates all airfields in one projected metre-scale world. Adds on-foot pilot, persistent parked fleet, boarding/exit, manual engine start, fuel use, installations and navigation with explicit full restart.

subject: Integrate supplied menu theme and spatial aircraft audio
technical_change: Adds menu theme, aircraft idle/flight and weapon recordings, offline conversion, audio buses/settings autoload, aircraft/weapon lifecycle components and native/web sample paths. Playback is owned by live aircraft and menus rather than previews.

subject: fix(terrain): unify Malta terrain rendering across local and web
technical_change: Adds explicit neutral StandardMaterial terrain override and separate default-off F4 heatmap; records the material-less COLOR_0 source and the un-reproduced Windows white appearance. Geometry, coordinates and flight remain unchanged in this commit.

subject: feat(terrain): add WWII-era Maltese landscape materials and details
technical_change: Replaces normal beige with bundled Mediterranean landscape ShaderMaterial/detail maps, adds MultiMesh landscape details and an initial simplified Valletta blockout, preserving opt-in heatmap. No runtime GIS downloads or shader displacement are introduced.

subject: fix(web): open directly to the game menu
technical_change: Removes the promotional landing/Play wrapper and repository footer link from the exported HTML shell, starts loading the engine automatically and opens the actual Godot game menu after a minimal progress/error overlay.

subject: feat(combat): add confirmed encounters and Malta Survival stages
technical_change: Introduces EnemyEncounters active/wreck lists, safe batch spawn planning, latched/deferred confirmation and generation cancellation. Adds Malta Survival stages 1,2,2,3,3 and an ace while preserving live player/world state between confirmations.

subject: feat(missions): add Italian aircraft and Valletta interception
technical_change: Adds resource-defined C.200, CR.42 and SM.79 visuals/flight/damage, bomber and escort pilots, defensive mounts, physical MissionBomb and the first Valletta interception director/menu with an initial single checkpoint and five-minute deadline.

subject: feat(missions): guide navigation to nearby Italian interception
technical_change: Replaces one trigger with five resource-defined sequential checkpoints, measured 2500 m player-to-formation insertion ahead, whole-run activation guards and bomber route pacing. Player state is not reset when the final checkpoint activates.

subject: fix(hud): clear enemy placeholder during mission navigation
technical_change: Clears the old enemy-placeholder status when interception has no spawned enemy, so checkpoint navigation does not misleadingly show a waiting or destroyed Stuka. Adds observable telemetry/assertion coverage.

subject: feat(audio): add commander interception radio call
technical_change: Adds supplied processed commander voice, MissionRadio single-shot subtitle/channel/mix handling and offline radio preparation; formation activation uses a 30-degree right bearing. Mixer temporarily ducks Aircraft/Guns without replacing saved levels.

subject: test(audio): wait for radio completion cleanup
technical_change: Waits until playing is false, subtitle hidden and radio channel released, accounting for the later finished callback. Documents the audio-thread/idle cleanup ordering; no speech or mission logic replacement.

subject: feat(mission): shorten interception to two checkpoints and 90 seconds
technical_change: Shortens the actual route to two nearby checkpoints, changes formation separation to 1200 m and deadline to 90 s, adds automatic ballistic release lead, vertical practical-spawn guards and crash effects. Results wait for expiry except immediate player loss.

subject: feat(character): replace pilot placeholder with rigged RAF model
technical_change: Replaces primitive pilot visuals with original skinned RAF GLB, generator and reusable avatar wrapper; integrates Idle/Walk/Seated and player cockpit stations while retaining ground collision and instant boarding/exit handoff.

subject: feat(defence): add friendly AA batteries to Malta airfields
technical_change: Adds supplied emplacement GLB integration, two autonomous guns per field, shared shell pool/FlakEffectPool, muzzle animation/audio and bomb-damage API. This initial autonomous control is later removed.

subject: feat(airfield): add manual AA controls and drivable military truck
technical_change: Removes friendly autonomous target selection/aim/fire, adds per-gun mounting/camera/reticle and exclusive AirfieldInteraction. Adds reference-inspired kinematic military truck with wheels/steering, camera, grounded safe exits and parking brake.

subject: fix(aa): retain enemy tags and add larger bursts with cannon reports
technical_change: Keeps hostile labels when the flight HUD is hidden for ground/gunner cameras; enlarges flak visuals, caps report voices and adds cannon-like AA sound at a two-shots/s cadence instead of the earlier machine-gun-like report.

subject: feat(aa): add severe proximity blast damage and devastating direct hits
technical_change: Raises direct-hit damage and introduces strong interpolated distance-based fragmentation using nearest component geometry/terrain cover; excludes directly struck aircraft from duplicate blast damage. Adds dedicated flak-damage checks.

subject: fix(terrain): integrate Malta airfields with smoothly graded ground
technical_change: Retains original source GLB but locally refines/grades runtime island mesh at airfield footprints with smooth transitions/coastal protection. Replaces raised slab floor collision with terrain-only support and millimetre-offset visual runway/apron surfaces.

subject: feat(terrain): add editable Malta road network integrated into ground
technical_change: Adds editable historic-scan trace/control data, projected road paths, constrained terrain refinement and UV road masks; partitions road ground into cullable patches. Documents geographic fit uncertainty rather than claiming surveyed road alignment.

subject: feat(missions): add six-wave manual AA defence against Stuka dives
technical_change: Adds six Stuka attack waves, state-driven bombing/strafe passes, vulnerable ground operator and mission-specific bomb cover damage. Tracks actual losses and retains live hostile ordnance through aircraft destruction before allowing next waves or success.

subject: feat(roads): connect Malta base entrances to parking and AA positions
technical_change: Adds generated base-entry/parking/AA connectors and focused terrain/apron access masks, metadata and truck-route checks. Routes avoid fixed buildings/spawns and preserve field geographic centres and mission logic.

subject: feat(aa): add four-gun heavy batteries and clip-fed Bofors defence
technical_change: Adds AAWeaponDefinition resources, four heavy and two Bofors per field, separate gravity pools, timed heavy versus impact light shells, location-specific damage and five-second heavy reload. Briefly adds finite stocks/four-round clips, later removed.

subject: feat(aa): add relative mouse aiming and sight zoom with unlimited ammunition
technical_change: Adds scoped relative mouse controls, rate-limited smoothing, sight zoom, user sensitivity persistence and pointer-lock recapture; increases heavy/light traverse independently. Removes finite ammunition/clip state, preserving automatic reload and heavy single-press/Bofors hold behaviour.

subject: feat(aa): add player-directed battery command and supplied defence audio
technical_change: Adds one player-operated command post per four-heavy-gun field battery, gravity interception solver, imperfect target/area designations and staggered orders to physical barrels. Integrates supplied briefing, air-raid alarm and descent-gated Jericho sounds.

subject: fix(audio): loop air-raid siren throughout defence mission
technical_change: Starts one looped air-raid siren at defence mission audio startup, keeps it through waiting/travel/waves and stops on outcome/cancel. Removes the previous per-wave/approach gating logic.

subject: feat(malta): add original fortified Valletta city to continuous world
technical_change: Adds original terrain-fitted Valletta buildings/fortifications/landmarks, chunked visual GLB and separate persistent coarse collision. Replaces earlier cheap landscape blockout and records approximate, not surveyed, reconstruction limits.

subject: feat(malta): reconstruct georeferenced fortified Mdina hilltop city
technical_change: Adds georeferenced fortified Mdina, hilltop sample, gate/road openings and city assets/tests. Extracts HistoricCity loader reused by Valletta/Mdina and adds projected Mdina chart marker without changing terrain.

subject: feat(cottonera): establish source-derived alignment and record missing geography
technical_change: Adds projected, cited GeoNames regional anchors and source-hash/alignment metadata. Records inaccessible historical/footprint sources and missing geography; anchors do not fabricate city boundaries.

subject: feat(cottonera): prepare footprint-driven Fort St Angelo template
technical_change: Adds footprint-driven Fort St Angelo architectural template construction to offline models module, awaiting an actual sourced outline; does not populate the fort at an invented world footprint.

subject: feat(cottonera): prepare Senglea housing and lookout assets without invented streets
technical_change: Adds original row-house and Gardjola-style lookout template geometry. Leaves actual Senglea streets/buildings absent pending source data rather than inferring a city from the image alone.

subject: feat(cottonera): prepare separate defensive-line walls bastions and gates
technical_change: Adds distinct curtain-wall, battered bastion and gate-opening model constructors for separate defensive systems. This is reusable template geometry, not a placed mapped perimeter.

subject: feat(cottonera): prepare source-placeable wartime dockyard assets
technical_change: Adds source-placeable warehouse, crane and dry-dock templates. No modern marina/yachts or invented historical dock positions are inserted into the live world.

subject: feat(cottonera): import sourced footprints roads and distinct defensive lines
technical_change: Adds local GeoJSON/OSM XML/Overpass importer requiring provenance, licence, epoch and explicit city assignment. Preserves polygons/holes, rejects incomplete geometry and distinguishes named defensive lines and modern exclusions.

subject: feat(cottonera): prepare footprint-driven church and palace landmark assets
technical_change: Adds footprint-driven church/palace constructors with distinct selectable landmark templates; schema/model availability does not establish the historical footprint or 1942 facade at runtime.

subject: feat(cottonera): integrate source-gated regions collision and review templates
technical_change: Adds source-gated regional compiler, collision/near-mid-far assets, runtime CottoneraRegion, continuous-world hook and standalone unplaced gallery. Empty source remains awaiting_geodata with no fabricated structures; review scene is not a gameplay city.

subject: test(cottonera): validate safe fallback LODs native web and missing-data workflow
technical_change: Adds importer/compiler/native/browser regression coverage and missing-data documentation; rejects incomplete source assemblies, corrects template dome normals, improves LOD/collision checks and gallery framing. Confirms safe empty fallback, not a completed populated Cottonera.
